notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: This is where you'll decide what the application notifies you about and how.

profile.heading: Profile of {firstName} {lastName}
profile.intro: This is your personal profile page. Here you can find your personal data.

stations.title: Stations
stations.intro: Start points and stations where vehicles refill water or unload cargo volume.
stations.empty: No stations have been created yet.
stations.routingDisabled: Routing is switched off in this installation.

dialog.description: Define where the station is and what vehicles refill or unload there.
dialog.nameTooLong: The name may be at most 255 characters long.
dialog.replenishesHint: Without a selection the station only serves as the start and end of a tour.
dialog.positionHint: Move the marker on the map to the location of the station.
dialog.positionRequired: Please set a position on the map.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete station?
deleteConfirm.description: The station {name} will be removed permanently.

transferDialog.title: Move station {name}
transferDialog.description: The station moves to the chosen organization and then serves its tours as start, end or stop.

toast.defaultSet: The station is now the default.

plugin.overviewIntro: A plugin connects an external system to Green Ecolution. It can write data and bring its own view. Select a plugin to manage its permissions and access.

install.title: Install plugin
install.deviceCapabilitiesHint: The view may use these device features once someone accepts the browser prompt. Only grant them to plugins you trust.
install.description: Connects an external system to Green Ecolution and issues it an API credential.
install.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Also used as the provenance tag on imported data, and cannot be changed afterwards.
install.targetProxiedHint: Service name and port inside the cluster, e.g. kataster.plugins.svc.cluster.local:8080. Only services on this installation's allowlist are accepted.
install.permissionsHint: These are the rights the plugin itself may use when it writes data into Green Ecolution.
install.accessPermissionsHint: Who may open the plugin's view. Starts out mirroring the plugin's own rights; the first change made here ends that mirroring for good. A view with action buttons hands the plugin's rights to whoever operates it — loosen these rights only deliberately.
install.slugInvalid: Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, not at the start or end.
install.slugReserved: The slug "{slug}" is reserved by the plugin api and cannot be used.
install.targetInvalidUrl: That is not a valid address.
install.targetRequiresHttps: The external address must use https (localhost excepted).
install.targetMatchesAppOrigin: The address must not be this application's own origin.
install.targetInvalidPort: The port must be between 1 and 65535.

keyDialog.installedDescription: Copy the key and store it wherever the plugin needs it.
keyDialog.rotatedDescription: The previous key is invalid from now on. Replace it everywhere the plugin uses it.
keyDialog.activationHint: The plugin starts out disabled. While it is, Green Ecolution rejects its adapter even with a valid key. Enable it on the detail page before you hand the key over.

detail.rotateConfirmDescription: The current key becomes invalid immediately. Update it wherever the plugin needs it.
detail.enableHint: A disabled plugin can no longer authenticate or write any data.
detail.uninstallConfirmDescription: {name} will be removed. The records it has already imported stay in Green Ecolution, but the link between them and the plugin is lost. If the same plugin is installed again later, it will not recognise those records and will import everything a second time.

toast.saveFailed: The plugin could not be saved.
toast.rotateFailed: The key could not be rotated.
toast.uninstallFailed: The plugin could not be uninstalled.
toast.installFailed: The plugin could not be installed.

view.proxiedNotice: This plugin is embedded through the internal proxy, but the proxy is not set up on this installation.
view.unsafeOriginNotice: This plugin's view is served from the same address as Green Ecolution and therefore cannot be displayed. A plugin has to be reachable under its own domain.

roles.emptyOwn: No own role yet. Copy a system role or create a new one.
roles.systemReadOnlyNoticeSuffix: the role to adjust permissions or create your own role.
roles.clampedAway_one: {count} permission was removed because you don't hold it yourself.
roles.clampedAway_other: {count} permissions were removed because you don't hold them yourself.
roles.unknownPermissionsHint: This view doesn't know these permissions. They are kept when saving.
roles.discardDescription: You have unsaved changes to this role.

deleteDialog.title: Delete role?
deleteDialog.description: {name} will be removed. People with this role lose the permissions it contains.

roles.leaveDescription: Your changes to this role haven't been saved yet.
roles.nameConflict: A role with this name already exists.
roles.notGrantable: You can only grant permissions you hold yourself.

toast.saveFailed: The role could not be saved.
toast.deleteFailed: The role could not be deleted.

members.emptyFiltered: No person matches the search and filter.
members.emptyUnfiltered: No members have been added yet.
members.profileHint: This information is used to assign people to watering plans.
members.wateringPlanSelectableHint: Only marked people appear in the selection of members linked to a watering plan.
members.rolesHint: Roles take effect immediately. A change doesn't need saving.
members.organizationHint: A person belongs to at most one organization. A change moves them immediately.
members.selfOrganizationLocked: Your own organization can't be changed here. Someone else with administrative rights has to do this.
members.selfRolesLocked: Your own roles can't be changed here. Someone else with administrative rights has to do this.
members.noOrganizationRolesLocked: Roles can't be assigned without an organization. Assign the person to an organization first.
members.roleErrorTooPowerful: This role contains permissions beyond your own.
members.roleErrorSelfAccount: Roles can't be changed on your own account.
members.organizationErrorForbidden: You aren't allowed to manage people in this organization.
members.organizationErrorSelfAccount: Your own organization can't be changed here.
members.notMatchingFilter: The selected person doesn't match the search and filter.

moveDialog.title: Move person?
moveDialog.descriptionWithSource: {name} moves from {from} to {to}. The change takes effect immediately, assigned roles remain in place.
moveDialog.descriptionWithoutSource: {name} is assigned to {to}. The change takes effect immediately, assigned roles remain in place.

members.discardDescription: You have unsaved changes to this person's profile.
members.leaveDescription: Your changes to this person's profile haven't been saved yet.

toast.roleAssignFailed: The role could not be assigned.
toast.roleRevokeFailed: The role could not be revoked.
toast.organizationChangeFailed: The organization could not be changed.
toast.profileSaveFailed: The profile could not be saved.

add.title: Add person
add.description: The person gets their own account in {name}.
add.usernameHint: This is what the person signs in with.
add.rolesHint: You can also assign roles later.
add.identityTaken: The username or email address is already taken.
add.failed: The person could not be created.
add.passwordHint: Hand the initial password over in person. It is only shown now, and the person has to change it at the first sign-in.
add.leaveDescription: The new person's initial password is only shown in this window. If you leave the page now, it cannot be shown again.

empty.titleOnlyMe: Nobody but you is in {name} yet
empty.description: Members are everyone who works with Green Ecolution for {name}, for example planning operations, working in the field or driving a vehicle.
empty.exampleLabel: Example: you and two more people with the roles Planning and Observer
empty.exampleLabelNone: Example: two people with the roles Planning and Observer
empty.benefitsTitle: What you can do with members
empty.accessText: Everyone signs in with their own account.
empty.rolesText: A role defines what someone may see and change.
empty.plansText: Availability and driving license classes show who can be assigned to an operation plan.
empty.note: Good to know: A person always belongs to one organization. You can move them to another one later.

areas.title: Areas of work
areas.intro: Switch on what is part of the work of {name}, and enter what planning should reckon with.
areas.followsTenant: This area of work is switched by the parent organization.
areas.readOnlyNotice: You can view the areas of work but not change them.
areas.loadErrorForbidden: You may not view this organization's areas of work. Your role probably applies to a sub-organization only.
areas.loadErrorGeneric: The areas of work could not be loaded. Please try again later.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: When a sensor counts as offline or suspect
sensors.offlineAfterHint: A sensor that stays silent this long counts as offline, and its last readings count as outdated.
sensors.defectStreakHint: This many unusable readings in a row until a sensor is flagged as suspect.

organization.loadErrorForbidden: You aren't allowed to view this organization. Your role probably only applies to a sub-organization.
organization.loadErrorGeneric: The organization structure could not be loaded. Please try again later.
organization.nameConflict: An organization with this name already exists.
organization.contactPersonNotAssigned: This person isn't assigned to this organization and can't be the contact person.
organization.readOnlyRootNotice: The top-level organization of this instance cannot be edited.
organization.locationHint: The address is optional, but can only be saved in full.
organization.deleteHint: An organization can only be deleted once it has no sub-organizations and no members left.

structure.title: Structure
structure.intro: Every organization you may manage. Click a name to open its settings.

empty.title: {name} has no sub-organizations yet
empty.description: A sub-organization is a separate area within {name}, for example a depot, a department or a contracted company.
empty.exampleLabel: Example: {name} with the sub-organizations Depot and Contracted company
empty.teamText: Each sub-organization has its own members and its own roles.
empty.dataText: Its members only see what belongs to their own sub-organization, for example vehicles, sensors and operation plans.
empty.overviewText: {name} keeps the overview. With the right permissions you still see everything from all sub-organizations.
empty.note: Good to know: A sub-organization can be renamed later, but not moved. It can only be deleted while it has no members and no sub-organizations of its own.

overview.areasNone: No area of work is switched on

deleteDialog.title: Delete organization?
deleteDialog.description: {name} will be removed. This is only possible while no sub-organizations and no members are assigned.

organization.leaveDescription: Your changes to this organization haven't been saved yet.

createDialog.title: Create sub-organization
createDialog.description: The new organization will be placed under {parentName}.

contactPicker.title: Choose contact person
contactPicker.description: Only people assigned to this organization can be the contact person.
contactPicker.empty: No people are assigned to this organization.

mapView.label: Map viewport
mapView.hint: Where the map opens and how far it may be panned. Members of this organization start in this extent and cannot move beyond it.
mapView.pickerHint: The visible extent becomes the boundary the map may pan in. The marker sets the point the map opens at.
mapView.pickerHintUnrestricted: The map is not penned in, so the visible extent does not matter. The marker sets the point the map opens at.
mapView.zoomHint: Lower values show more ground, higher values more detail.
mapView.previewAriaLabel: Preview of the viewport in force
